'''SOC''' is a Star Wars CCG writing handle on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The DS II & Beyond index credited that handle for Bothan OPS! and CC Troopers.<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15lite.htm Bothan OPS!], The Outer Rim (SOC). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155334/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
